module: Catch-all gameplayInterface module: connection test (ping) and opening/closing of the latches of advanced coupler controllers (advancedCouplerControl).
notes: Action 'latchesOpen'(): calls detachGroup() on each controller of type advancedCouplerControl.
Action 'latchesClose'(): calls tryAttachGroupImpulse() on each controller of type advancedCouplerControl.
latchesOpen/latchesClose do not check their parameters.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called at load: fills moduleActions and moduleLookups.

requestRegistration.desc: Registers the actions and lookups with gameplayInterface.
